verdict.rationale: Guidance text was extracted from several public esd.wa.gov pages (home, employer requirements, unemployment taxes, quarterly-report filing), which shows the reading surface returned real content to a keyless fetch. Probes on the same host returned clean HTTP 404s rather than a challenge page. The probe of secure.esd.wa.gov found a SecureAccess Washington login shell, but it describes that host as the authenticated transactional portal and separate from the open guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit probe record confirming the identified user agent and the absence of a CAPTCHA, bot wall or JS-only shell on esd.wa.gov guidance pages, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent reachability.
